primary_metric: mean average precision across all six final held-out mechanisms and all three seeds; validation screen reports mean AP over clean, MCAR 0.2, MCAR 0.4, and anchor-MAR across all seeds
choice_rule: Freeze ADMIB as implemented. Strongest matched control is selected by highest validation mean AP among the fixed non-ADMIB arms with equal four-copy row count and booster capacity. Report all fixed arms; do not tune from final outcomes.

selected_parameters.imputer: sklearn IterativeImputer(BayesianRidge, max_iter=5, tol=0.001, skip_complete=True, random_state=seed), fitted on masked 80% training subset only
selected_parameters.propensity: StandardScaler + multinomial LogisticRegression(max_iter=100, C=0.5); probabilities clipped to [0.05,1], inverse clipped to [0.25,4], normalized within regime then globally
selected_parameters.augmentation: three additional masked copies per training row: MCAR p=0.2, MAR from observed anchor x0 with sigmoid propensity, and random block mask over columns 2:8; paired control uses three independent MCAR p=0.2 copies
selected_parameters.prediction_interface: masked feature matrix only; no condition name or held-out labels

prior_art_status: closest identified overlap: MIRRAMS (arXiv:2507.08280) explicitly targets unseen missingness shifts; impute-then-regress and NeuMiss are established (arXiv:2106.00311); robustness depends on shift mechanism (arXiv:2406.16484). No novelty claim.
